hook_text: EXMPL is up 29% today. The business is not.
audio_script: EXMPL is [PROP: chart-ride-up = +29%] up twenty nine percent today, on five times average volume, so the internet has decided it is a [DOODLE: injokes/rocket-to-the-moon] technology company again. [BEAT] The news is an AI partnership. A press release, not a purchase order, and [PROP: c-press-release-crumple] nobody has attached a revenue number to it yet. Plus [DOODLE: concepts/hype-vs-reality] squeeze chatter, because eleven percent of the float was betting against it. [DRY] Gut check. I read the filings so you don't have to. Revenue went four hundred million to four ninety six in five years, which is [PROP: c-number-deflate = $496M] growth you need a [DOODLE: concepts/zzz-boring] magnifying glass to find. Losses got wider every single year, and [PROP: chart-off-cliff = -$89M] eighty nine million went out the door last time. Free cash flow turned negative in twenty two and [PROP: b-long-fall-line = -$15M] stayed there. Then the share count. [PROP: see-saw-two-numbers = heavy:365M, light:298M] Two hundred and ninety eight million shares became three hundred and sixty five, which is how management quietly sends you the [DOODLE: injokes/holding-the-bag] bill. [SIGH] Eleven times earnings, and every number underneath it is [PROP: numbers-raining = -$8M, -$25M, -$49M, -$70M, -$89M, -$11M, -$15M] going the wrong way. Cheap only counts if the sliding stops. The chart went vertical. The business went [DOODLE: poses/shrug-idk-man] sideways. [BEAT] Noise. A press release and a squeeze, stapled to five years of drift. Set a reminder for the next 10-Q.

headlines.meaning: A press release, not a purchase order — no revenue attached.
11% of the float is short. The crowd noticed and piled in.

numbers_comment: Revenue has flatlined for three years while losses widen and the share count grows six percent a year. The business is going sideways; the stock is going vertical.
cheap_or_trap: Eleven times earnings looks cheap. It only is if revenue stops sliding, and it has not stopped sliding.
conclusion: Noise. A press release and a squeeze, stapled to five years of drift. Set a reminder for the next 10-Q.
